verdict.rationale: Rollbar has an in-product AI agent (Resolve), so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence only documents Rollbar's own MCP server, which serves Rollbar data to other agents. That is the server role and cannot be credited to this client story. Nothing shows users can plug third-party MCP servers into Rollbar or its agent so it can use their tools.
